source: share, ppp: NBA.com Synergy team offensive play types (data/raw/synergy/teams.json). pace and the rates: NBA.com player box scores added up per team game (data/raw/games/PlayerStatisticsExtended.csv), regular season only (NBA Cup group and knockout games in, Cup final out); the box scores lack 6 of 2024-25's 1230 games. blend: 1/3 2024-25 + 2/3 2025-26. league: mean and population SD over the 30 teams (blend: of the blended values). games: the regular-season games counted. Built by scripts/data/styles.ts.

fields.share: share of the team's plays by Synergy play type: NBA.com frequencies over these ten kinds, normalised to sum to 1 ("misc" left out)
fields.ppp: points per play in each play type (NBA.com Synergy)
fields.pace: possessions per 48 minutes: FGA + 0.44*FTA - ORB + TOV, averaged with the opponent's, per game, over game minutes (overtime counted)
fields.tovPerPoss: turnovers credited to players, per possession (the averaged estimate above). Team turnovers (shot clock, 5- and 8-second violations) are not in the player box scores, so they are in neither this nor the possession estimate: per the play-by-play they ran 0.80 a team-game in 2024-25 and 0.71 in 2025-26 (5% of all turnovers, about 0.0073 a possession in the blend, nearly the same for every team); add that to compare with a turnover count that includes them
fields.opp: the same four for the team's opponents, i.e. what its defense allows (opp.orbPct = 1 - its DRB%)
